name: BTC Macro Correlation: SPY, Gold & VIX Regimes
description: Rolling 60-day Pearson correlation between Bitcoin and two major macro assets — SPY (S&P 500) and Gold (GLD) — with VIX regime analysis. BTC/SPY correlation is split by VIX regime: high fear (VIX >= 20, orange) vs low fear (VIX < 20, blue). A dedicated VIX level chart shows volatility spikes. Summary table includes mean BTC/SPY correlation under each VIX regime alongside overall stats for both pairs.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC MACRO CORRELATION: SPY & GOLD
# =============================================================================
# Rolling 60-day Pearson correlation between Bitcoin and two major macro assets
# Area fills: blue = positive (moving together), orange/amber = negative (diversifying)
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_btc = src.c

spy = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
close_spy = spy.c

gld = reference_stocks(ticker='GLD')()
close_gold = gld.c

# VIX Index for regime classification
vix_src = indices(ticker='VIX')()
vix_level = vix_src.c

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================================

corr_spy = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=close_btc, y=close_spy)
corr_gold = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=close_btc, y=close_gold)

# ============================================================================
# REGIME SPLITS FOR AREA FILLS
# ============================================================================

# BTC/SPY: positive vs negative correlation
spy_positive = where(corr_spy >= 0, corr_spy)
spy_negative = where(corr_spy < 0, corr_spy)

# BTC/Gold: positive vs negative correlation
gold_positive = where(corr_gold >= 0, corr_gold)
gold_negative = where(corr_gold < 0, corr_gold)

# ============================================================================
# VIX REGIME SPLITS FOR BTC/SPY CORRELATION
# ============================================================================

# High fear: VIX >= 20; Low fear: VIX < 20
corr_spy_high_fear = where(vix_level >= 20, corr_spy)
corr_spy_low_fear = where(vix_level < 20, corr_spy)

# Mean correlation by VIX regime (for summary stats)
# Use where to isolate, then aggregate in summary table

idx = index()

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: BTC vs SPY Correlation by VIX Regime
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY Correlation by VIX Regime',
    category='Correlation Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Low Fear (VIX < 20)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='High Fear (VIX >= 20)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, corr_spy_low_fear, corr_spy_high_fear)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: VIX Level Over Time
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='VIX Level (Fear Gauge)',
    category='Correlation Analysis',
    y_axis_label='VIX',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=20, title='Fear Threshold (20)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, vix_level)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: BTC vs Gold Rolling Correlation
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs Gold: Rolling 60-Day Correlation',
    category='Correlation Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Moving Together', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Diversifying', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=2
)(idx, gold_positive, gold_negative)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Correlation Stats by Pair + VIX Regime
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation Summary',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['BTC / SPY (All)', 'BTC / SPY (VIX >= 20)', 'BTC / SPY (VIX < 20)', 'BTC / Gold (All)'],
        col_headers=['Mean', 'Min', 'Max', 'Current'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='Correlation Analysis',
    order=3
)(corr_spy, corr_spy, corr_spy, corr_spy, corr_spy_high_fear, corr_spy_high_fear, corr_spy_high_fear, corr_spy_high_fear, corr_spy_low_fear, corr_spy_low_fear, corr_spy_low_fear, corr_spy_low_fear, corr_gold, corr_gold, corr_gold, corr_gold)
